subtasks.title: Initialize Next.js Project
subtasks.description: Use `npx create-next-app@latest .` to initialize a new Next.js project in the current directory. When prompted, select the following options: TypeScript, ESLint, Tailwind CSS, `app` router, and the default import alias (`@/*`). This will set up the foundational structure and dependencies.

subtasks.title: Add and Initialize shadcn-ui
subtasks.description: Add `shadcn-ui` to the project for a set of high-quality UI components. Run `npx shadcn-ui@latest init` and follow the prompts, accepting the default options. This will set up the necessary configuration and utilities for using the components.

subtasks.title: Set up Prettier for Code Formatting
subtasks.description: Install Prettier and its necessary plugins (`prettier-plugin-tailwindcss`, `eslint-config-prettier`) to ensure a consistent code style. Create a `.prettierrc` configuration file and a `.prettierignore` file. This will help maintain code quality and readability.
Establish a more organized file structure for scalability. Create a `lib/utils.ts` file for helper functions. Clean up the default content in `app/page.tsx` to prepare for the application's main UI.
subtasks.title: Organize Project Directory Structure
Create a Basic Todo List UI
subtasks.description: Implement a basic, non-functional UI for a todo list on the main page (`app/page.tsx`). Use `shadcn-ui` components like `Card`, `Input`, `Button`, and `Checkbox` to create the layout. This serves as a placeholder and demonstrates the use of the UI library.
